title: AI Flow production health and SLO
description: Seven-day production health, ticket autonomy, rescue results, repeated study-case signatures and AI usage from aiflow_events.

panels.title: Blocked by signature
panels.description: Blocked tickets grouped by exact block kind and reason.

queries.query: SELECT kind, reason AS signature, count(*) AS blocked FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ticket.blocked' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY kind, reason ORDER BY blocked DESC

panels.title: Time in each status
panels.description: Total and average minutes spent in each status for transitions in the seven-day window.

queries.query: SELECT from_status, round(sum(minutes_in_from), 1) AS total_minutes, round(avg(minutes_in_from), 1) AS average_minutes, count(*) AS transitions FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ticket.status' AND minutes_in_from IS NOT NULL AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY from_status ORDER BY total_minutes DESC

panels.title: Done without human action
panels.description: Count and share of tickets reaching Done without a human-review or externally observed Jira status change.

queries.query: WITH done AS ( SELECT ticket, max(_timestamp) AS done_at FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ticket.done' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY ticket ), human_action AS ( SELECT ticket FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ticket.human_review' UNION SELECT ticket FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ticket.status' AND source = 'observed' ) SELECT 'last 7 days' AS window, count(*) AS done_tickets, sum(CASE WHEN human_action.ticket IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done_without_human_action, round(100.0 * sum(CASE WHEN human_action.ticket IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS done_without_human_action_pct FROM done LEFT JOIN human_action ON human_action.ticket = done.ticket

panels.title: Rework per ticket
panels.description: Rework event count and highest recorded round for each ticket.

queries.query: SELECT ticket, count(*) AS rework_events, max(round) AS highest_round FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ticket.rework' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY ticket ORDER BY rework_events DESC, ticket

panels.title: Master rescues and result
panels.description: Operator rescue runs grouped by incident and result.

queries.query: SELECT incident, result, count(*) AS rescue_runs, round(sum(minutes), 1) AS ai_minutes FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'operator.run' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY incident, result ORDER BY rescue_runs DESC, incident

panels.title: Repeated signatures after a study case
panels.description: Identical rework headlines after a same-ticket recall that included a study case.

queries.query: WITH case_recalls AS ( SELECT ticket, min(_timestamp) AS recalled_at FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'memory.recall' AND case_ids IS NOT NULL AND case_ids <> '' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY ticket ), rework_after_case AS ( SELECT rework.ticket, rework.headline AS signature FROM "aiflow_events" AS rework JOIN case_recalls ON case_recalls.ticket = rework.ticket AND rework._timestamp >= case_recalls.recalled_at WHERE rework.event = 'ticket.rework' AND rework.headline IS NOT NULL AND rework.headline <> '' AND rework._timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' ) SELECT signature, count(*) AS repeats, count(DISTINCT ticket) AS affected_tickets FROM rework_after_case GROUP BY signature HAVING count(*) > 1 ORDER BY repeats DESC, signature

panels.title: AI minutes
panels.description: AI run minutes by agent and role.

queries.query: SELECT agent, role, round(sum(minutes), 1) AS ai_minutes FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ai.run' AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY agent, role ORDER BY ai_minutes DESC

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Known input, output and total tokens by agent and role.

queries.query: SELECT agent, role, sum(input) AS input_tokens, sum(output) AS output_tokens, sum(total) AS total_tokens FROM "aiflow_events" WHERE event = 'ai.usage' AND usage_known = true AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY agent, role ORDER BY total_tokens DESC
